programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
programs.desc: When night falls, a different type of traveler crosses the border -- and cartel spotters are nearby watching; a truck driver's modified cab is carrying a secret commodity; officers find a surprise in a car that has never crossed the border before.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
programs.desc: In their battle against the cartels, Customs and Border Protection flag a tractor-trailer transporting tanks of liquid methamphetamine; officers nab an exotic reptile smuggler; 36 pounds of cocaine are found inside a pickup truck.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: A Scottish teenager claims that he's come to meet his girlfriend from a gaming website; when a couple arrives with a large amount of cash split into bundles, officers dig deeper and see that the man is under investigation by the FBI.

programs.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
programs.desc: In Atlanta, an officer discovers evidence of a lottery scam -- a tactic used by criminals to trick victims into giving up thousands of dollars in exchange for alleged winnings. This find could lead CBP to uncover the network behind this nefarious ploy.

programs.title: Body Cam
programs.desc: In Ohio, police fight to save the life of a woman held at knifepoint by a violent criminal. In Georgia, two repeat offenders lead police on a perilous pursuit, and in California, a Sheriff's helicopter unit battles to save a man clinging to a cliff.

programs.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
programs.desc: Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.
